name: Walk-in shower
description: Floor-level shower corner: hinged glass door (up to 80 wide, a fixed panel fills wider fronts) + optional side panel in thin chrome frames, 200 high; rain head (Ø25) on an arm from the back wall at 210, bar mixer at 105, hand shower on an 80 cm rail, square floor drain. Origin back-centre of the shower area. Double-click the door to open.

doorSide.description: left | right: end of the front the door hinges at (and the side panel closes); the other end is the room wall
